title: Unlogic’s Optimum Optimill MH50V LinuxCNC conversion
scope: Three separate owner-reported Delta DB44 peripherals, complete 227-contact V2 P1 inventory, separate historical Mesa wiring interpretation, and dotted hypothetical V2-to-TI AM26LV31E interface proposal. The proposed retrofit is not fitted or electrically qualified.
